title: Lightning climbing an object: a charge crawls along the clicked object and jumps from its tips (one workflow, app passes)
server: ComfyUI >= 0.41.2 with comfyui-element-forge, ComfyUI-GGUF; queue via /prompt

inputs.label: Point on the object x (plate px, frame 0)
Point on the object y (plate px, frame 0)
Object word: all alike objects (e.g. all sticks of a crown; off = the clicked one)
Lightning look: without LTX (drawn bolts, no AI run)
Effect prompt (with LTX)
inputs.default: Raw electrical discharge filmed at night with a high-speed camera: jagged, branching lightning bolts and crackling arcs against a pure black background. Irregular zigzag filaments that split again and again into thin forks, white-hot cores with violet-blue edges, sparks jumping between points, every bolt a different shape, flickering violently from frame to frame. No glowing tubes, no neon, no straight rods, no light sabers: only real lightning. Everything else is completely black, static camera, photorealistic.

inputs.label: Element depth offset (+ = nearer, less hidden)
Frames from the start of the clip
